_comment: Copy to import-overrides.json (git-ignored — contains personal data) and fill in the real values. known_shared_emails: e-mail addresses confirmed to be used by two different people in the submissions. email_abstract_coauthors: hand-verified co-author lists for the abstracts that were submitted by e-mail (their Evaluated ID column holds the literal 'email' and they are absent from All_Submissions); keyed by Id_Sub code.
